name: Blush Call
summary: A cute video call where a bunny and a bear blow kisses across the screen
about: A sweet video call page for people far apart. A bear rings, you pick up, and a bunny and a bear appear in two little rooms that show day or night from the real time in each city. Blow a kiss and a heart flies across with a trail, lands with a blush and comes straight back; send a hug, mute, turn the camera off or hang up to see how many kisses you shared. Put in names, cities and a first message, then send it as a link.
how: The call rings: press Accept (or Decline to see a missed call and call back).
Press Blow a kiss: the bunny leans back, puckers up and throws a heart that flies across, the bear blushes and blows one back.
Try Hug, Mic and Camera; the bear also chats and blows kisses on its own while you are on the call.
Press End to hang up and see the call time, kisses and hugs; Call again rings once more.
In Send it, change names, cities and the first message, copy the link and send it; with reduced motion every action still works without flying.
